assessment.headline: Possible change river-condition anomaly at Pra Reach P11
assessment.explanation: On 2026-11-06 the satellite sediment indicator at Pra Reach P11 (P11) read +0.058. Given the season, recent rainfall and upstream conditions, +0.035 would have been expected — the reading is 1.1 standard deviations above that. Rainfall over the preceding 7 days totalled 28 mm, which is drier than normal for this time of year. The index here is 0.111 higher than the nearest upstream station (P10). This is the first observation showing the change. Observation quality is ACCEPTABLE; overall confidence is moderate. This indicates unusual surface-water conditions that may warrant investigation. It does not identify a cause, and it does not demonstrate mining activity or the presence of any specific contaminant.
assessment.recommended_action: No immediate action. Confirm on the next pass before treating this as a genuine change.
